blocks.text: For years, SM Supermalls has brought sports and wellness closer to every Filipino through its facilities, tournaments, and community events. As more Filipinos embrace an active lifestyle, SM Supermalls is broadening its quest of providing more opportunities and spaces to stay fit. SM Supermalls is opening a new chapter by bringing its efforts together under one brand: SM Active. Evolving from SM Active Hub, SM Active is SM Supermalls’ broader vision to make active living part of everyday life for more Filipinos. Through SM Active, individuals and communities will experience a more integrated active ecosystem, making their experiences more meaningful and […]...
